hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A bonding curve and AMM graduation hook for token launches. Sells newly-minted tokens through a single-sided Uniswap v4 bonding curve pool until the supply cap is reached, then automatically migrates liquidity to a full-range AMM pool. Charges a 5% swap fee on each trade, split 1% platform, 1% creator, and 3% to a reward pool via afterSwapReturnsDelta.
